intro: Dynatrace R&D has grown from hundreds to thousands, and now agents are producing code, tests, and artifacts — more power than we've ever had. That scale moves {roleWord} up: closer to the problem, the customer, and the value. It's on us to deliver. Here's what it means to you.

eng.do: implement a simple solution that does the job
eng.dont: build for a potential future problem

architect.dont: a framework for a problem you may never have

product.do: focus on customer value, cut the rest

manager.dont: a bit of everything: low value, high effort

mantras.title: show, don't tell
mantras.sub: demo over docs. results tell more than 1000 words.

eng.dont: show how beautiful the spec is

design.do: show it running, not the slideware

manager.dont: present a status deck about the work

mantras.title: think customer-first
mantras.sub: understand the real pain. ask 5x why.

eng.do: make it work in 5 minutes for a developer who has never seen us

architect.do: design for the real constraint, not the ask

design.do: solve the job, not the request

product.dont: build the request before understanding the pain

manager.do: understand the ask before the team builds it
manager.dont: forward the request without the why

mantras.title: don't reinvent the wheel
mantras.sub: if it exists, use it. if you don't like it, make it better.

eng.do: reuse and contribute back — make the shared things better
eng.dont: build a new parser / client / wrapper because yours will be cleaner

architect.do: standardize and enhance the proven building blocks
architect.dont: a homegrown framework for something standard tools already do

design.do: build from the design system as much as possible
design.dont: a one-off component that breaks consistency

product.do: reuse the flow customers already know
product.dont: invent a new pattern for a solved problem

manager.do: review and adopt the team's proven way of working

mantras.title: you build it, you own it
mantras.sub: the model suggests. you decide. every line that merges is yours.

eng.do: watch your change in prod after it ships

architect.do: live with the design you chose
architect.dont: pick the pattern, leave others to run it

design.do: follow the feature into real usage
design.dont: hand off the mocks and disappear

product.do: own the outcome, not just the launch

manager.do: take the incident, shield the team, fix the system
